from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyROAInput(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single document required for ROA calculation."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code or ticker symbol of the company")
    net_profit_attributable: float | None = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders for the quarter")
    total_assets_ending: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets at the end of the reporting period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2025 Q1'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the financial figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate class capturing all company financial data found across the document collection."""
    companies: list[CompanyROAInput]
